title: Reduced pricing for GitHub-hosted runners usage
summary: Reduced costs for GitHub-hosted runners are now in effect.[^c-2ae2ab5166]

title: Welcome to 2026, A Growth Year for All of Us
Gemini 3 Flash is now available in Visual Studio, JetBrains IDEs, Xcode, and Eclipse
summary: Gemini 3 Flash is available in public preview to Copilot Enterprise, Copilot Business, Copilot Pro, and Copilot Pro+.[^c-a758a3c5d3] You’ll now be able to access the model in GitHub Copilot Chat on github.com, GitHub Mobile, Visual Studio Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains IDEs, Xcode, and Eclipse through the chat model picker (agent, ask, and edit modes).[^c-f474f6a2fb] If you do not yet have access, please check again later.[^c-91860ea72a]

title: Why AI is pushing developers toward typed languages
summary: AI is settling the “typed vs. untyped” debate by turning type systems into the safety net for code you didn’t write yourself.[^c-55405fa152]

title: Chat picker is based on agent sessions
summary: The Quick Pick for chat sessions is now based on the same information that drives the Agent Sessions view.[^c-b0073d5881] You can access any previous chat session from there and perform actions like archiving, renaming or deletion.[^c-791f12c9f6]

title: Chat title improvements
summary: The Chat view title control is now showing up, irrespective of how the Activity Bar is configured.[^c-f4414108be] Previously, it only showed up in the default Activity Bar configuration.[^c-b9ed07019e] To quickly jump from one session to another, select the chat title to open the sessions Quick Pick and choose another session.[^c-7db1b5bd57]

title: Open empty Chat on restart
summary: From now on, previous chat sessions are not automatically restored when VS Code is restarted.[^c-5afcb0e681] Instead, an empty Chat view is shown where you can then access previous sessions from the Agent Sessions control.[^c-d406c304ec]

title: Terminal tool auto approve default rules
Add session and workspace rules for future terminal tool commands
summary: The allowed commands or command line entries in the Allow dropdown now have options a corresponding action to allow them for the current session or for the workspace.[^c-b64ba70bb1]

title: Terminal tool preventing adding to shell history
summary: When shell integration is enabled and working, commands that are run by the terminal tool are no longer included in shell history for bash, zsh, pwsh and fish.[^c-b149099f97] The method this uses differs for each shell, for bash for example HISTCONTROL=ignorespace is set and a space is added to the start of the command being run.[^c-b64d744489]

title: Streaming chat responses in Accessible View
summary: The Accessible View now dynamically streams chat responses as they are generated.[^c-cbb0421311] Previously, you needed to close and reopen the Accessible View to see updated content.[^c-c4eb1c03d4] Now, you can stay in the Accessible View and monitor output as it comes in, making it much easier to follow along with AI responses in real-time.[^c-81b8256df3]

title: MCP server output excluded from Accessible View
Language ID variable in window title
Import profile by drag and drop
summary: You can now import a settings profile by dragging and dropping a .code-profile file into VS Code.[^c-7a47a80870]

title: Copy breadcrumbs path
summary: You can now copy the breadcrumbs path to the clipboard by using the Copy Breadcrumbs Path command.[^c-635548d66e]

title: Go to Symbol in Workspace supports special characters in query
Authoring commit messages using the editor
Worktrees in the Source Control Repositories view (Experimental)
Terminal IntelliSense default UX rework
summary: During the past two releases, we rolled out terminal IntelliSense to all VS Code Stable users.[^c-ba6cc42490] While much of the feedback was positive, there was a segment of users (mostly terminal power users) that did not like the feature breaking their muscle memory.[^c-69aadfde85] After a lot of discussion, we decided to switch some defaults, improve discoverability and allow easier inline configuration of the feature.[^c-16a5e179b4]

title: More comprehensive custom glyphs
summary: The terminal's GPU accelerated renderer (on by default) has supported custom glyphs for some time for box drawing, block element, and a subset of powerline symbols.[^c-5a81a1f855]

title: Improved rendering of curly underlines
summary: VS Code has been able to parse and display colored and styled underlines for some time now, but the curly underline's rendering always left something to be desired.[^c-a42b74dbc2] The curly underlines should now look very close to how they look in the editor.[^c-35c6f78d86]

title: Organize breakpoints by file
summary: Breakpoints can now be shown as a tree, grouped by their file.[^c-ca1e112b4a]
